group.title: Quality hold notice
group.passage:
QUALITY NOTICE — Lot K724

During the final inspection of lot K724, three units showed scratches on the display window. Electrical tests passed on all units. The entire lot has been placed on hold while the cause of the cosmetic damage is investigated.

Do not ship, rework, or mix these units with other lots. Move the sealed cartons to the marked quarantine area. Quality will inspect the window surfaces and decide which units can be released.

Production on the next lot may continue using the revised protective-film procedure. This notice applies only to K724 and does not authorize scrapping any product.
group.passageZh:
品質通知——K724 批次

K724 批次的最終檢驗發現三台設備的顯示窗有刮痕。所有設備皆通過電氣測試。調查外觀損傷原因期間，整批產品暫停放行。

不得出貨、重工或將這些設備與其他批次混放。請將封好的紙箱移到標示清楚的隔離區。品管部會檢查顯示窗表面，決定哪些設備可以放行。

下一批可使用修訂後的保護膜作業程序繼續生產。本通知僅適用 K724，並未授權報廢任何產品。
